How booking works: request your appointment below — no payment yet. We confirm your date and window by text, and only then do you pay the $65 service call (secure SwipeSimple card link, or Venmo, Cash App, Zelle or PayPal) to lock in your spot. It covers our trip out to you, and it stays as the trip charge. Cancel 2 or more hours before your appointment window and the $65 is refunded in full — no cancellation fees, ever. If your vehicle needs in-depth testing, a full diagnostic is $150, paid when we diagnose (up to an hour of testing — some faults are genuinely time-consuming to trace). And if you hire us for a repair with $300 or more in labor, the $150 diagnostic is credited toward the repair bill — so on a $300 labor job, you only pay $150 more in labor when the work is done.

No-Title Vehicles: We Run a VIN Lien & Theft Check Before Completing the Purchase

          

            No-title quotes are a flat $30 — you do not need a VIN to get or submit your quote. Before we complete a no-title purchase, we run a quick VIN check ourselves so we know the vehicle is not held by a bank (lien) and is not stolen:
            
    
              
  1. NICB VINCheck (free) — theft & insurance total-loss records
    2. 
              
  2. NMVTIS title & lien report (VinAudit) — searches state DMV title and lienholder records
    3. 
              
  3. Oregon DMV title record check — the final word on Oregon liens
    4. 
            

            Disclaimer: a photo ID is necessary at the transaction. Registration is preferred, but not mandatory. If a bank lien shows up on our check, we can only complete the purchase with a lien release from that bank — we will walk you through it.
            

            
That one click is enough to process your quote and arrange the transaction — nothing else is required.

Hybrid & EV Batteries — Diagnose → Choose → We Install

      

        

          
          

            
Red triangle of death? Code P0A80? MPG dropping?

            
Don’t guess a $2,000 battery. Start with our $65 Hybrid Battery Health Check — we come to you, scan every battery block, test the cooling fan and 12V battery, and tell you honestly whether you need a pack, a fan, a 12V battery, or nothing at all.

            
Check first: many 2020+ Toyotas — and cars in CARB states like Oregon — carry a 10-year / 150,000-mile factory hybrid battery warranty. If yours is still covered, the dealer replaces it free, and we’ll tell you.

            

              Call / Text 360-772-8205
              Text to Book Health Check
            

          

        

      

    


    

      
Installed Hybrid Battery Replacement — We Come To You

      

        
Pack prices below are typical installed ranges (pack + our mobile installation). Your exact quote depends on the tier you choose and your VIN — some model years use two different battery chemistries, so we always confirm fitment by VIN first. The battery warranty is with the pack supplier; our installation labor is covered by our 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty. Core charge is handled through the supplier — no surprises.

        

          

            
            
Toyota Prius Gen 2 / Gen 3

            
2004–2015 Prius, Prius V & Prius c. The most common hybrid battery job in America.

            
Installed from ~$1,195 – $2,894

            
Reconditioned (1-yr) → New-module (up to lifetime tiers)

            
          

          

            
Toyota Camry Hybrid / Lexus CT 200h

            
Camry, Avalon, Highlander & RAV4 Hybrids and Lexus CT/RX hybrids.

            
Installed from ~$1,300 – $2,800

            
Reconditioned & remanufactured tiers, 1–3 yr pack warranties

            
          

          

            
Honda Civic Hybrid / Insight

            
IMA hybrids 2000–2015, plus Ford Escape / Fusion Hybrid.

            
Installed from ~$999 – $2,350

            
Reman from $999 (12-mo) → new-cell packs (36-mo)

            
          

        

        

          
Good — Reconditioned
Tested modules, weak ones replaced, pack rebalanced. ~$900–$1,500 · 6–18 mo warranty · expect 2–4 more years.

          
Better — Remanufactured
Fully disassembled, modules matched, wear parts replaced. ~$1,500–$2,600 · 1–3 yr warranty.

          
Best — New Modules
Brand-new cells in a rebuilt case. ~$1,550–$2,950 · 2–4 yr warranty, lifetime tiers exist · expect 4–6+ years.

        

        
Other hybrids & EVs (Chevy Volt, Nissan, Hyundai/Kia): text us your VIN — 360-772-8205 — and we’ll price it honestly.

Know Before You Buy

      

        
Codes P0A80, P3011–P3024 mean “replace hybrid battery” or a weak block — but a clogged cooling fan or a dying 12V battery can trigger the same warnings. Diagnose first.

        
Core charges explained: every pack carries a refundable core deposit (about $500–$1,350) until your old pack goes back to the supplier. When we install, we handle the core return for you.

        
Fine print: battery prices, warranties and core charges are set by the seller/supplier and can change. Your pack warranty is with the manufacturer/seller named at purchase; Redemption Mobile Service LLC warrants its installation labor under its standard 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty. Always confirm fitment by VIN before ordering.
